package.name: kislayphp_socket
package.summary: KislayPHP Socket provides realtime socket transport for long-running PHP services.
package.description: KislayPHP Socket provides realtime socket transport with WebSocket and polling support for long-running PHP services. Part of the KislayPHP suite.
package.notes: Release 1.0.0 (first stable-milestone tag): native WebSocket transport, Redis pub/sub relay, event-driven on()/onAuth()/join() callbacks with Zend-safety serialization, cross-extension civetweb symbol isolation, fixed a 100%-reproducible onAuth() null-pointer crash.
